_doc: Drives portfolio-gate's voice memory-loop probe in CI. The toolSecretHeader override is deliberately ABSENT: Kira now uses the package's canonical x-convai-tool-secret. It previously carried "x-kira-tool-secret" — a Kira-local name for a portfolio-wide mechanism, i.e. a fork, and one that forced the SHARED probe to grow this option purely to accommodate a single repo. The option stays in portfolio-gate for products that genuinely need a different name; Kira is no longer one of them. The route still ACCEPTS the legacy header until every agent is re-provisioned, which is exactly why the probe should exercise the canonical path.
